provenance.calibration: virgil-vlti 3395e78: virgil-vlti-calibrate --dual-field --diameter 0.5 --tf-error propagated --bin 1 --window 2.05 2.38 --insname GRAVITY_SC --allow-unrecorded --cp-only-when-uncalibrated.
